candidates.name: Leiomyosarcoma
support_spans: A 10 cm mass was palpable in pelvic cavity, fixed to anterior rectum, with clear boundary, hard texture, significant tenderness and limited mobility.
MRI showed multiple soft tissue shadows with uneven signals, blurred margin with adjacent rectum and sigmoid colon
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings suggest a large pelvic mass, which could be consistent with a leiomyosarcoma.
